minutes.headline: Parks Commission agreed to stay closed and wing it on the summer beach season, with no motion made.
minutes.summary: The remote meeting covered the recreation director's update, mowing and field maintenance, and ideas for Fitzgerald field including turf. The main item was the summer beach season: members agreed to hold off on hiring and beach passes, wait for the governor's guidance, and possibly meet again in late May. The only vote was to adjourn.

budget_items.what_was_said: Registration is kept hidden so the town does not incur refund costs if summer programs are cancelled.
Members said a turf field would be priced by square footage and could be rented out to offset cost; no money identified.
Members favoured not selling beach passes this summer, and possibly taking payment at the door if the beach opens.
Maintenance wants the old bathrooms demolished, noting questions about available finances.

decisions.decision: Stay the course: keep the beach closed and make no summer hiring or pass-selling plans for now, with no motion needed.
Recreation director to put a summer 2020 notice in the beach section of the website.
No meeting scheduled now; possibly meet at the end of May if needed.
Members to share thoughts on Fitzgerald field with the recreation director to formulate a plan for a later agenda.
If restrictions lift, groups postponed from spring may use the fields in summer without returning to the Commission.

what_happened.line: Members agreed by consensus, with no motion, to keep the beach closed and make no summer hiring or pass-selling plans for now.
The recreation director is to post a summer 2020 notice in the beach section of the town website.
Members will send their thoughts on Fitzgerald field, including a turf idea, to the recreation director to shape a plan for a later agenda.
If restrictions lift, groups postponed from spring may use the fields in summer without returning to the Commission.
No meeting was scheduled; the Commission may meet at the end of May if needed, and the only vote was to adjourn.

why_it_matters: Whether the town beach opens this summer, and whether passes or swim lessons are sold, depends on state guidance and was left undecided, so families should not count on a beach season yet.
A turf field at Fitzgerald would be a capital cost with no money identified, so any proposal would later raise a question of taxes or other funding.
